report: Reviewed the complete keyed_reuse claim, both implementation entries, and the sole associated test after a fresh start. Requirements are: (1) raw and lowered facts have the same narrow key, (2) lowering observes only its corresponding owned provider fact, (3) repeated unchanged demand reuses the lowered value without a new raw request, and (4) unrelated provider changes preserve that value. The ordinary external_trait_signature entry is real partial implementation: a Salsa tracked function keyed by SymExt requests TcxDb::trait_signature using that symbol's crate number and definition index, then lower_trait_signature/lower_generics/lower_predicate/lower_ty construct the owned Sage result from the returned fact. No additional provider requests occur in this trait-signature lowering path, and the tracked wrapper supplies memoization for repeated requests within the current provider lifetime. Other tracked product entry points are visible in the same file; this is not evidence of a complete separately tracked raw layer. Captured tcx/mod.rs and db.rs show an ordinary owned-data trait service stored as Arc<dyn TcxDb>, with no independently tracked provider-fact inputs or per-fact update interface. The new explicit implementation TODO accurately preserves these absent obligations rather than reclassifying the working trait-signature lowering. It additionally documents that lower_associated_type_value loads external_impl_signature to obtain binder generics, so that path does not yet have the claim's single provider-fact dependency. Its prerequisite is provider facts that own the necessary binder information plus definition/product-keyed tracked inputs and update/invalidation plumbing. Consequently the strong two-layer reuse and unrelated-provider-edit guarantees remain deferred; they are not approved as implemented. The complete associated test set is sage_meta::todo::metadata_keyed_reuse only. Its empty function has no behavioral assertions and is not runtime verification. Its explicit TODO specifies cold/warm exact raw/lowered traces, absence of warm execution, relevant-key invalidation, and unrelated-key preservation/backdating. This is a justified deferred matrix pending the provider representation/update mechanism documented by the implementation TODO. There are no N/A entries. Source inspection establishes the current narrow trait lowering and the architecture gaps; no behavioral regression was claimed or executed. Ran cargo fmt and cargo build successfully (existing warnings emitted). The edit adds only an explanatory TODO module/association; no executable implementation or test behavior changed. The coordinator will run centralized delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks. All claim aspects are accounted for as partial implementation plus explicit implementation/test deferrals; no further edits requested for this review.
